descriptionMarkdown:
A combinator-based system that automatically builds the required production line from a single central configuration. It assigns assemblers and intermediate products based on the requested products and automatically sets the appropriate recipes.

The current version can construct the production line, but resource supply and machine input/output control are still under development. The next goal is a separate control circuit that requests resources based on current demand, limits machine loading and unloading, and stops production when the defined maximum stock level is reached.
title: Automatically builds the production line
